title: Ilmiy maqola uslubida yozish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ilmiy maqolaning IMRaD tuzilmasini farqlay olasiz, da’volarni dalilga mos ehtiyotkor va aniq bayon qilasiz, manbalarga to‘g‘ri havola berasiz va besh elementli annotatsiya yozasiz.

scenes.title: Ilmiy maqola uslubi
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda siyosat va xalqaro munosabatlar lug‘atini o‘rgandik. Bugun yozuvning eng talabchan turlaridan biriga o‘tamiz: ilmiy maqola uslubi. Dars oxirida maqolaning to‘rt bo‘limini farqlaysiz, fikringizni ehtiyotkor va aniq bayon qilasiz, boshqa mualliflarga to‘g‘ri havola berasiz va ikki yuz ellik so‘zlik annotatsiya rejasini tuzasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we explored the vocabulary of politics and international relations. Today we turn to scientific writing: how to build an article, hedge responsibly, cite accurately and sound objective.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. Oldingi safar siyosat va xalqaro munosabatlar lug‘atini o‘rgandik. Bugun ilmiy yozuvga o‘tamiz: maqolani qanday qurish, mas’uliyat bilan ehtiyotkor bo‘lish, aniq havola berish va xolis eshitilish.

scenes.title: Nega ilmiy uslub alohida

examples.t: The data suggest a modest association.

scenes.say_native: Ilmiy yozuvning vazifasi o‘quvchini ishontirish emas, balki dalillarni tekshirib ko‘rishga imkon berishdir. Shuning uchun uch narsa muhim: aniqlik, ehtiyotkorlik va xolislik. Aniqlik raqam va atamalarda ko‘rinadi. Ehtiyotkorlik da’voning kuchini dalil darajasiga moslaydi. Xolislik esa muallifning hissiyotini chetga qo‘yadi.
scenes.say: Academic readers do not want to be persuaded by enthusiasm. They want claims that match the evidence, terms that are exact, and a tone that keeps the author out of the way.
scenes.say_uz: Akademik o‘quvchi ishtiyoq bilan ishontirilishini xohlamaydi. U dalilga mos da’volarni, aniq atamalarni va muallifni chetda qoldiradigan ohangni kutadi.

scenes.title: Maqola tuzilishi: IMRaD
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy va ijtimoiy fanlardagi ko‘pchilik maqolalar bir xil tuzilgan. Avval annotatsiya, ya’ni abstract, keyin kirish, metod, natijalar va muhokama. Qisqartmasi IMRaD: Introduction, Methods, Results, and Discussion. Bu tuzilma o‘quvchiga kerakli joyni tez topishga yordam beradi.
scenes.say: Most empirical articles follow the same order: an abstract, then an introduction, methods, results and discussion. Readers jump between sections, so each section must do only its own job.
scenes.say_uz: Aksar empirik maqolalar bir tartibda quriladi: annotatsiya, kirish, metod, natijalar va muhokama. O‘quvchilar bo‘limlar orasida sakraydi, shuning uchun har bo‘lim faqat o‘z vazifasini bajarishi kerak.

scenes.title: Abstract nimalardan iborat
scenes.say_native: Abstract maqolaning o‘ziga to‘liq mustaqil qisqa nusxasi. Unda beshta element bo‘ladi: fon, maqsad, metod, asosiy natijalar va xulosa yoki amaliy ahamiyat. Odatda ikki yuz–ikki yuz ellik so‘z bo‘ladi. Abstractda havola kam ishlatiladi, jadval yoki rasmga murojaat qilinmaydi va yangi ma’lumot kiritilmaydi, ya’ni maqola ichida yo‘q narsa abstractda ham bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: An abstract is a stand-alone miniature of the article. It states the background, the aim, the method, the key findings and the conclusion, usually in around two hundred words.
scenes.say_uz: Abstract maqolaning mustaqil kichik nusxasi. Unda fon, maqsad, metod, asosiy topilmalar va xulosa beriladi, odatda ikki yuz so‘z atrofida.

scenes.title: Namunaviy abstract
board: Read it and spot the five elements
scenes.say_native: Endi namunani tinglang. Diqqat qiling: bir gap fonni, ikkinchisi maqsadni beradi, so‘ng metod va natijalar o‘tgan zamonda, xulosa esa ehtiyotkor so‘zlar bilan keladi. Beshta elementni ketma-ket toping va har birining qaysi gapda ekanini belgilab boring. Raqamlar aniq, “muhim” so‘zi esa faqat statistik ma’noda ishlatilgan.
scenes.say: Sleep is widely believed to support memory consolidation, yet evidence from adolescents remains limited. This study examined whether sleep duration predicts recall in teenagers. Two hundred and forty students completed a word-recall task after a controlled night of sleep. Recall improved significantly after nine hours compared with six hours. These findings suggest that school start times may merit reconsideration.
scenes.say_uz: Uyqu xotirani mustahkamlashga yordam beradi deb keng ishoniladi, ammo o‘smirlar bo‘yicha dalillar cheklangan. Ushbu tadqiqot uyqu davomiyligi o‘smirlarning esda tutishini bashorat qilishini o‘rgandi. Ikki yuz qirq o‘quvchi nazorat ostidagi tundan keyin so‘z eslash vazifasini bajardi. To‘qqiz soatlik uyqudan keyin eslash olti soatlikka nisbatan sezilarli yaxshilandi. Bu topilmalar maktab boshlanish vaqtini qayta ko‘rib chiqishga arzishini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Namunani tahlil qilamiz

examples.t: This study examined whether...

scenes.say_native: Tahlil: fon hozirgi zamonda — “Sleep is widely believed”. Maqsad va metod, ya’ni “examined”, “completed”, o‘tgan zamonda, chunki tadqiqot allaqachon bajarilgan. Natija ham o‘tgan zamonda: “recall improved significantly”. Xulosada yana hozirgi zamon va ehtiyotkor so‘zlar: “suggest”, “may merit”. Sub’yekt “this study”, ya’ni “I”, “we” emas.
scenes.say: Notice the tense logic: the present for established background, the past for what was done and found, and a cautious present for the conclusion. The subject is the study, not the author.
scenes.say_uz: Zamon mantig‘iga e’tibor bering: ma’lum fon hozirgi zamonda, bajarilgan ish va topilmalar o‘tgan zamonda, xulosa esa ehtiyotkor hozirgi zamonda. Sub’yekt muallif emas, tadqiqotning o‘zi.

scenes.title: Kirish: bo‘shliqni ko‘rsatish
board: 2 But a gap exists: little is known about...

examples.t: However, little is known about X.
examples.uz: Biroq X haqida kam narsa ma’lum.

examples.t: The present study addresses this gap.

scenes.say_native: Kirish uch qadamdan iborat. Birinchi: mavzuning ahamiyatini ko‘rsatasiz. Ikkinchi: bilimdagi bo‘shliqni aytasiz, odatda “However” bilan: “However, little is known about…”. Uchinchi: sizning tadqiqotingiz shu bo‘shliqni qanday to‘ldirishini bildirasiz: “This study aims to…”
scenes.say: A strong introduction has three moves: establish the topic, identify a gap with a contrast signal such as however, then state how the present study fills that gap.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli kirish uch qadamdan iborat: mavzuni o‘rnatish, “however” kabi qarama-qarshilik signali bilan bo‘shliqni ko‘rsatish, so‘ng tadqiqot uni qanday to‘ldirishini aytish.

scenes.title: Shaxsiy uslub xatosi
board: ✗ In this research I want to talk about...
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato — og‘zaki uslubni ko‘chirish. “I want to talk about” maktab inshosiga o‘xshab eshitiladi. Ilmiy ishda tadqiqot bajaradi: “This study examines”, “This paper argues”. Yana bir xato — kutilmagan so‘z “research” ni sanash: “researches” yoki “a research” deyish.
scenes.say: Avoid conversational openings such as I want to talk about. Let the study act: this study examines, this paper argues. And remember that research is uncountable: a study, or a piece of research.
scenes.say_uz: Og‘zaki ochilishlardan saqlaning. Tadqiqotning o‘zi harakat qilsin: bu tadqiqot ... ni o‘rganadi, bu maqola ... deb ta’kidlaydi. Research sanalmaydigan ot ekanini unutmang.

scenes.title: Bo‘limni toping
board: 4 This may reflect limited sample size.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap bor. Har birining qaysi bo‘limdan ekanini toping: introduction, methods, results yoki discussion. Zamonga, majhul nisbatga va ehtiyotkor so‘zlarga qarang: ular bo‘limni ko‘rsatadi. Har bir gapni ichingizda o‘qing, keyin javobni baland ovozda ayting. Biroz o‘ylab ko‘ring, javoblar keyingi qismda.
scenes.say: One: Participants were recruited online. Two: Scores rose by twelve per cent. Three: Little is known about X. Four: This may reflect limited sample size.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: ishtirokchilar internet orqali jalb qilindi. Ikki: ballar o‘n ikki foizga oshdi. Uch: X haqida kam narsa ma’lum. To‘rt: bu tanlanma hajmining cheklanganligini aks ettirishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: metod, chunki ishtirokchilarni jalb qilish tadqiqot jarayonini tasvirlaydi va o‘tgan zamondagi majhul nisbat ishlatilgan. Ikkinchi: natijalar, chunki faqat raqam keltirilgan, izoh yo‘q. Uchinchi: kirish, chunki “little is known” bilimdagi bo‘shliqni bildiradi.
scenes.say: One: methods. Two: results. Three: introduction. Four: discussion. The tense and the hedge tell you which section you are in.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: metod. Ikki: natijalar. Uch: kirish. To‘rt: muhokama. Zamon va ehtiyotkor so‘z qaysi bo‘limda ekaningizni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Metod: aniq va takrorlanadigan
board: Detail so another researcher can replicate

examples.t: Participants (N = 240) were randomly assigned to two groups.
Responses were analysed using a mixed-effects model.
examples.uz: Javoblar aralash effektlar modeli yordamida tahlil qilindi.

scenes.say_native: Metod bo‘limining qoidasi: boshqa tadqiqotchi sizning ishingizni takrorlay olishi kerak. Shuning uchun nima, kim, qancha, qanday, deb batafsil yoziladi. Odatda o‘tgan zamon majhul nisbati ishlatiladi: “Data were collected”, “Participants were assigned”. Bu yerda ish bajaruvchi kim ekanligi muhim emas, jarayon muhim.
scenes.say: The methods section is a recipe that another researcher could follow. It uses the past passive, because the process matters more than the person, and it gives numbers, tools and procedures.
scenes.say_uz: Metod bo‘limi boshqa tadqiqotchi takrorlay oladigan retsept kabi. Unda o‘tgan zamon majhul nisbati ishlatiladi, chunki jarayon shaxsdan muhimroq, hamda raqamlar, vositalar va tartib beriladi.

scenes.title: Natijalar: izohsiz

examples.t: Figure 2 shows a steady decline in recall.
Scores increased by 12 per cent (p < .05).

scenes.say_native: Natijalar bo‘limida faqat nima topilganini aytasiz, nega shunday bo‘lganini emas. “Figure 2 shows”, “Table 1 presents” kabi iboralar rasm va jadvalga yo‘naltiradi. Statistik ma’noda “significant” deganda p qiymati belgilangan chegaradan, odatda nol nuqta nol besh dan, kichik bo‘lishini nazarda tutasiz.
scenes.say: The results section reports what was found, with numbers, and points to figures and tables. Interpretation is saved for the discussion, and significant is reserved for statistical significance.
scenes.say_uz: Natijalar bo‘limi nima topilganini raqamlar bilan aytadi va rasm hamda jadvallarga ishora qiladi. Izoh muhokamaga qoldiriladi, “significant” esa statistik ma’noda ishlatiladi.

scenes.title: Muhokama: izoh, cheklov, ahamiyat
board: Limitations: This study was limited by...

examples.t: These results are consistent with Walker (2017).
examples.uz: Bu natijalar Uoker (2017) bilan mos keladi.

examples.t: A larger sample would be needed to confirm this.
examples.uz: Buni tasdiqlash uchun kattaroq tanlanma kerak bo‘ladi.

scenes.say_native: Muhokamada avval asosiy natijani qisqa eslatasiz, so‘ng uni izohlaysiz va avvalgi tadqiqotlar bilan solishtirasiz. Keyin ochiq tan olingan cheklovlar keladi: “This study was limited by…”. Cheklovni yashirmaslik ishonchni kamaytirmaydi, aksincha oshiradi. Oxirida amaliy ahamiyat va keyingi tadqiqotlar uchun takliflar beriladi.
scenes.say: The discussion restates the main result, interprets it, compares it with earlier work, admits limitations honestly and suggests implications and future research. Honesty about limits strengthens credibility.
scenes.say_uz: Muhokama asosiy natijani qayta eslatadi, izohlaydi, oldingi ishlar bilan solishtiradi, cheklovlarni ochiq tan oladi va ahamiyat hamda keyingi tadqiqotlarni taklif qiladi.

scenes.title: Natija bilan izohni aralashtirish
board: ✗ Results: Scores rose, which proves the method works.
✓ Results: Scores rose by 12 per cent.
✓ Discussion: This may indicate that the method is effective.
scenes.say_native: Yana bir klassik xato: natijalar bo‘limida izoh berish. “Scores rose, which proves the method works” — bu yerda ikki muammo bor. Birinchisi, izoh natijalarga tegishli emas. Ikkinchisi, “proves” juda kuchli so‘z: bitta tadqiqot hech narsani isbotlamaydi. Natijalarda faqat raqam, muhokamada esa ehtiyotkor izoh: “This may indicate that…”
scenes.say: Keep results and interpretation apart. Scores rose by twelve per cent is a result. This may indicate that the method is effective is an interpretation. And a single study almost never proves anything.
scenes.say_uz: Natija va izohni ajrating. Ballar o‘n ikki foizga oshdi — natija. Bu usul samarali ekanini ko‘rsatishi mumkin — izoh. Va bitta tadqiqot deyarli hech qachon hech narsani isbotlamaydi.

scenes.title: Ehtiyotkorlik: hedging nima
board: Hedging = matching claim strength to evidence
It may be that..., This suggests...

examples.t: This suggests that the effect is real.
It is possible that other factors contributed.
examples.uz: Boshqa omillar ham hissa qo‘shgan bo‘lishi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Hedging, ya’ni ehtiyotkor ifodalash, ikkilanish emas. Bu da’vo kuchini dalil kuchiga moslashdir. Agar ma’lumot yetarli bo‘lmasa, “X causes Y” deb yozish halollikka zid. “X may contribute to Y” esa aniqroq, chunki u sizning haqiqiy ishonch darajangizni ko‘rsatadi. Inglizcha ilmiy yozuvda hedging juda keng ishlatiladi va o‘quvchilar buni mutaxassislik belgisi deb biladi.
scenes.say: Hedging is not weakness. It is accuracy about certainty. If the evidence is partial, X may contribute to Y is a more honest and more expert claim than X causes Y.
scenes.say_uz: Hedging ojizlik emas, ishonch darajasi haqida aniqlik. Dalil to‘liq bo‘lmasa, X Y ga hissa qo‘shishi mumkin degan da’vo X Y ni keltirib chiqaradi degandan halolroq va mutaxassisona.

scenes.title: Hedging vositalari
board: Phrases: to some extent, in most cases

examples.t: Participants appeared to benefit.
This is arguably the main cause.
examples.uz: Bu, ehtimol, asosiy sabab deyish mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Vositalar to‘rt guruhga bo‘linadi. Modal fe’llar: may, might, could. Leksik fe’llar: suggest, indicate, appear to, tend to. Ravishlar: possibly, arguably, generally, apparently. Va iboralar: to some extent, in most cases, up to a point. Muhim: “appear” va “seem” dan keyin infinitiv keladi, “appear that” ham mumkin, ya’ni “it appears that”
scenes.say: Four toolkits: modals such as may and could, lexical verbs such as suggest and tend, adverbs such as arguably and generally, and fixed phrases such as to some extent.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt vosita: may va could kabi modallar, suggest va tend kabi fe’llar, arguably va generally kabi ravishlar hamda to some extent kabi turg‘un iboralar.

scenes.title: Haddan oshirilgan da’vo
board: ✗ This proves that social media causes anxiety.
✓ This suggests that heavy social media use may be associated with anxiety.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi xato — haddan tashqari qat’iylik: “proves”, “always”, “never”, “everyone”. Bu so‘zlar ko‘pincha noto‘g‘ri bo‘ladi, chunki istisno topiladi. Ikkinchi xato — bog‘liqlik, ya’ni correlation bilan sababni, causation ni, aralashtirish. Ikki hodisa birga o‘zgarsa ham, biri ikkinchisini keltirib chiqargan bo‘lishi shart emas.
scenes.say: Be careful with proves, always, never and everyone. Association is not causation: say may be associated with unless your design really shows a cause.
scenes.say_uz: Proves, always, never va everyone so‘zlaridan ehtiyot bo‘ling. Bog‘liqlik sabab emas: dizayn haqiqatan sababni ko‘rsatmasa, may be associated with deng.

scenes.title: Gapni yumshating
board: 1 This proves that homework is useless.
scenes.say_native: Uchta qat’iy gapni ilmiy ehtiyotkor shaklga o‘tkazing. Har birida bitta hedging vositasini ishlating: modal, fe’l yoki ravish. Gapni baland ovozda to‘liq ayting. Esda tuting: mazmun saqlansin, faqat da’vo kuchi dalilga mos bo‘lsin. Javoblar keyingi qismda, lekin avval o‘zingiz urinib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Soften these three claims. One: This proves that homework is useless. Two: Bilingual children are smarter. Three: Prices will fall next year.
scenes.say_uz: Bu uch da’voni yumshating. Bir: bu uy vazifasi foydasiz ekanini isbotlaydi. Ikki: ikki tilli bolalar aqlliroq. Uch: narxlar kelasi yil tushadi.

scenes.title: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar
board: 1 This suggests that homework may have limited benefits.
2 Bilingual children tend to perform better on some attention tasks.
3 Prices are likely to fall next year.
scenes.say_native: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar. Birinchisi: “This suggests that homework may have limited benefits.” Ikkinchisi: “Bilingual children tend to perform better on some attention tasks”, bu yerda “some” ham aniqlik beryapti. Uchinchisi: “Prices are likely to fall next year.” Sizning variantingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi — bitta aniq vosita va mazmunning yo‘qolmasligi.
scenes.say: Possible answers: This suggests that homework may have limited benefits. Bilingual children tend to perform better on some attention tasks. Prices are likely to fall next year.
scenes.say_uz: Mumkin javoblar: bu uy vazifasi cheklangan foyda berishi mumkinligini ko‘rsatadi. Ikki tilli bolalar ba’zi diqqat vazifalarida yaxshiroq natija berishga moyil. Narxlar kelasi yil tushishi ehtimol.

scenes.title: Aniqlik: raqam va atama
board: Quantify: 62 per cent, a third, roughly 40

examples.t: Roughly forty per cent of respondents agreed.
examples.uz: Respondentlarning taxminan qirq foizi rozi bo‘ldi.

examples.t: Smoking affects lung function.

scenes.say_native: Aniqlik uch narsadan iborat. Birinchi: imkon bo‘lsa, miqdorni aytasiz: “sixty-two per cent”, “roughly a third”. Ikkinchi: “significant” ni faqat statistik ma’noda ishlating, aks holda “substantial” yoki “considerable” deng. Uchinchi: tez-tez adashiladigan juftliklar: “affect” fe’l, “effect” ot.
scenes.say: Precision means numbers where possible, significant only in the statistical sense, the verb affect and the noun effect, and consistent terminology. Do not swap a technical term for a synonym.
scenes.say_uz: Aniqlik: imkon bo‘lsa raqam, significant faqat statistik ma’noda, affect fe’l va effect ot, hamda atamalarni izchil saqlash. Texnik atamani sinonimga almashtirmang.

scenes.title: Noaniq so‘zlar
board: ✗ A lot of people / many things
✓ A substantial increase of 35 per cent
scenes.say_native: Kundalik so‘zlar ilmiy matnni zaiflashtiradi. “A lot of people” o‘rniga “a majority of respondents” yoki aniq foiz. “Things” o‘rniga aniq ot: “factors”, “variables”. “Very big” o‘rniga “substantial”, yanada yaxshisi raqam. Ayniqsa “very”, “really”, “thing” ni qidirib o‘chiring.
scenes.say: Replace everyday vagueness with exact language: not a lot of people but roughly sixty per cent of respondents, not very big but a substantial increase. Hunt down very, really and thing.
scenes.say_uz: Kundalik noaniqlikni aniq tilga almashtiring: a lot of people emas, respondentlarning taxminan oltmish foizi; very big emas, sezilarli oshish. Very, really va thing so‘zlarini qidirib toping.

scenes.title: Aniqroq qiling
board: 2 There was a big change in things.
3 The results are significant (we liked them).
scenes.say_native: Uchta noaniq gapni aniqroq qilib qayta yozing, yoki og‘zaki ayting. Taxminiy raqamlar o‘ylab toping va aniq ot ishlating. Uchinchi gapda “significant” so‘zining noto‘g‘ri ishlatilishini ham tuzating. Javoblar keyingi qismda, avval o‘zingiz urinib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Make these more precise. One: Many people were very unhappy. Two: There was a big change in things. Three: The results are significant, in the everyday sense.
scenes.say_uz: Buni aniqroq qiling. Bir: ko‘p odamlar juda norozi edi. Ikki: narsalarda katta o‘zgarish bo‘ldi. Uch: natijalar muhim, kundalik ma’noda.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 Nearly half of respondents reported dissatisfaction.
2 Staffing levels rose by 20 per cent.
scenes.say_native: Mumkin javoblar. Birinchi: “Nearly half of respondents reported dissatisfaction.” Ikkinchisi: “Staffing levels rose by twenty per cent”, bu yerda “things” o‘rniga aniq ot, “big” o‘rniga raqam. Uchinchisi: agar p qiymati hisoblanmagan bo‘lsa, “significant” emas, “encouraging” yoki “substantial” deymiz.
scenes.say: Nearly half of respondents reported dissatisfaction. Staffing levels rose by twenty per cent. The results were encouraging, or substantial, unless a statistical test was run.
scenes.say_uz: Respondentlarning deyarli yarmi norozilikni bildirdi. Kadrlar soni yigirma foizga oshdi. Statistik sinov o‘tkazilmagan bo‘lsa, natijalar umidli yoki sezilarli edi.

scenes.title: Havola tili: ikki usul

examples.t: Walker (2017) argues that sleep is vital.
Sleep is vital (Walker, 2017).

scenes.say_native: Havolaning ikki turi bor. Integral — muallif gapning bir qismi: “Walker (2017) argues that…”. Nointegral — muallif qavs ichida: “Sleep is vital (Walker, 2017)”. Birinchisi muallifga, ikkinchisi g‘oyaga urg‘u beradi. Uch va undan ko‘p muallif bo‘lsa “et al.” ishlatamiz: “Walker et al. (2017)”
scenes.say: Citations can be integral, where the author is part of the sentence, or non-integral, where the source sits in brackets. With three or more authors, write et al. Always follow the required referencing style.
scenes.say_uz: Havola integral bo‘lishi mumkin, bunda muallif gap tarkibida, yoki nointegral, bunda manba qavsda. Uch va undan ortiq muallifda et al. yoziladi. Doim talab qilingan havola uslubiga amal qiling.

scenes.title: Reporting verbs: kuch farqi

examples.t: Lee (2019) demonstrates a clear link.
Lee (2019) claims a clear link.
examples.uz: Li (2019) aniq bog‘liqlik bor deb da’vo qiladi.

scenes.say_native: Reporting verbs, ya’ni keltirish fe’llari, sizning munosabatingizni ham bildiradi. “States”, “notes”, “reports” betaraf. “Demonstrates”, “establishes” — siz natijaga ishonasiz. “Suggests”, “proposes” — ehtiyotkor. “Claims”, “alleges” esa masofa saqlaydi, ya’ni siz da’voga to‘liq qo‘shilmaysiz.
scenes.say: Reporting verbs carry your stance. Demonstrates signals trust, suggests is tentative, and claims keeps a distance. Do not treat claim as neutral: readers hear doubt in it.
scenes.say_uz: Keltirish fe’llari sizning pozitsiyangizni ham ko‘rsatadi. Demonstrates ishonchni, suggests ehtiyotkorlikni, claims esa masofani bildiradi. Claim ni betaraf deb o‘ylamang.

scenes.title: Havoladagi xatolar
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: “Lee say” deb yozish, aslida bitta muallif bo‘lsa, “Lee says” yoki “argues”. Ikkinchisi: “According to Lee, he argues” — ikki marta havola bergan bo‘lasiz. “According to” ning o‘zi yetarli, keyin fe’l qo‘shilmaydi. Uchinchisi: yil va betlarni tashlab ketish. Havola o‘quvchiga manbani topish imkonini berishi kerak.
scenes.say: Three typical errors: a missing third-person s, doubling the attribution with according to plus a reporting verb, and forgetting the year. The reader must be able to find the source.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta xato: uchinchi shaxs s sini tushirish, according to bilan keltirish fe’lini birga qo‘yib ikki marta havola berish va yilni unutish. O‘quvchi manbani topa olishi kerak.

scenes.title: Keltirish fe’lini tanlang
board: 1 Smith (2018) ___ that the data are unreliable. (doubt)
scenes.say_native: Har bir gap uchun mos keltirish fe’lini tanlang: shubha bildiradigan, ishonchli va ehtiyotkor. Misol uchun claims, demonstrates, suggests so‘zlarini sinab ko‘ring. Gapni to‘liq ayting va uchinchi shaxs s sini unutmang. Fe’lni tanlashdan oldin manbaning kuchini va o‘z munosabatingizni o‘ylab oling. Javoblar keyingi qismda.
scenes.say: Choose a reporting verb. One: Smith, twenty eighteen, blank, that the data are unreliable. Two: Chen, twenty twenty, blank, a strong link. Three: Okafor, twenty sixteen, blank, that diet may matter.
scenes.say_uz: Keltirish fe’lini tanlang. Bir: Smit, 2018, ... ma’lumotlar ishonchsiz deb. Ikki: Chen, 2020, ... kuchli bog‘liqlik. Uch: Okafor, 2016, ... ovqatlanish muhim bo‘lishi mumkin deb.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3 Okafor (2016) suggests that diet may matter.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “claims”, chunki biz ma’lumotlar ishonchsizligiga to‘liq qo‘shilmaymiz yoki masofa saqlaymiz. Ikkinchi: “demonstrates”, ishonchli natija. Uchinchi: “suggests”, ehtiyotkor, va “may” bilan mos keladi. Eslang, “suggests” bilan “may” juft ishlatilsa ham, bu ortiqcha hedging emas, chunki original muallifning ehtiyotkorligi aks etyapti.
scenes.say: One: claims. Two: demonstrates. Three: suggests. The verb should match both the source's strength and your own stance towards it.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: claims. Ikki: demonstrates. Uch: suggests. Fe'l manbaning kuchiga ham, sizning unga munosabatingizga ham mos bo‘lishi kerak.

scenes.title: Xolislik: majhul nisbat va nominalizatsiya
board: Impersonal: It is widely accepted that...

examples.t: Samples were tested at 20 degrees Celsius.
The growth of urban populations raises concerns.

scenes.say_native: Xolislik uchta usul bilan beriladi. Birinchisi — majhul nisbat: kim qilgani emas, nima qilingani muhim bo‘lganda. Ikkinchisi — nominalizatsiya: fe’l yoki sifatni otga aylantirish, masalan “populations grow” o‘rniga “the growth of populations”. Bu zichroq va rasmiyroq eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Objectivity comes from the passive voice, nominalisation and impersonal structures such as it is widely accepted that. Use the passive when the process matters, not when it hides who is responsible.
scenes.say_uz: Xolislik majhul nisbat, nominalizatsiya va it is widely accepted that kabi shaxssiz tuzilmalardan keladi. Majhul nisbatni jarayon muhim bo‘lganda ishlating, mas’ul shaxsni yashirish uchun emas.

scenes.title: Nimadan qochish kerak

examples.t: Do not → The study does not...

scenes.say_native: Ilmiy yozuvda qisqartmalar, ya’ni don’t, can’t, ishlatilmaydi: to‘liq “do not” yoziladi. Hissiy so‘zlar, masalan “terrible” yoki “amazing”, ham mos emas, chunki ular dalil emas, baho. Ritorik savollar ham og‘zaki uslubga xos. Birinchi shaxs masalasi fanga bog‘liq: ko‘p ijtimoiy fanlarda “I argue” qabul qilinadi, tabiiy fanlarda esa “we” yoki majhul nisbat yoziladi.
scenes.say: Avoid contractions, emotive vocabulary and rhetorical questions. First person is accepted in some disciplines and avoided in others, so check the journal's guidelines.
scenes.say_uz: Qisqartmalar, hissiy lug‘at va ritorik savollardan saqlaning. Birinchi shaxs ba’zi fanlarda qabul qilinadi, ba’zilarida yo‘q, shuning uchun jurnal yo‘riqnomasini tekshiring.

scenes.title: Xolis qilib qayta yozing
board: 2 I believe that kids learn faster.
3 The test was really hard for them.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni xolis akademik ohangda qayta yozing. Qisqartmani oching, hissiy so‘zni neytral so‘z bilan almashtiring, “I believe” ni hedging bilan almashtiring. Gapni baland ovozda ayting. Majhul nisbatdan foydalanish mumkin, lekin mazmunni o‘zgartirmang. Javoblar keyingi qismda, avval o‘zingiz yozib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Rewrite these objectively. One: We didn't find anything amazing. Two: I believe that kids learn faster. Three: The test was really hard for them.
scenes.say_uz: Xolis qilib qayta yozing. Bir: biz hech qanday ajoyib narsa topmadik. Ikki: menimcha bolalar tezroq o‘rganadi. Uch: test ular uchun juda qiyin edi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2 Children appear to learn more quickly.
3 The test proved challenging for participants.
scenes.say_native: Mumkin javoblar. Birinchi: “No notable effects were observed” — qisqartma yo‘q, majhul nisbat, hissiy so‘z yo‘q. Ikkinchi: “Children appear to learn more quickly” — “I believe” o‘rnida “appear to”. Uchinchi: “The test proved challenging for participants”, bu yerda “prove” ma’nosi “bo‘lib chiqdi”, isbotlash emas.
scenes.say: No notable effects were observed. Children appear to learn more quickly. The test proved challenging for participants, where prove means turned out to be.
scenes.say_uz: Sezilarli ta’sirlar kuzatilmadi. Bolalar tezroq o‘rganadiganga o‘xshaydi. Test ishtirokchilar uchun qiyin bo‘lib chiqdi, bunda prove so‘zi bo‘lib chiqdi degan ma’noda.

scenes.title: Dialog: ilmiy rahbar bilan
board: Supervisor: Then say so, and hedge the conclusion.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Doktorant ilmiy rahbar bilan annotatsiya haqida gaplashadi. Ikki narsaga quloq soling: rahbar qaysi element yetishmayotganini aytadi va qaysi so‘z haddan ortiq qat’iy ekanini ko‘rsatadi. Tushunmagan joyingiz bo‘lsa, xafa bo‘lmang: dialogdan keyin uchta savol beraman va javoblarni birga tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Supervisor: Your abstract is clear, but I cannot see the gap. Student: Well, most studies focus on adults. Supervisor: Then say that explicitly. And you wrote that this proves the effect. Could we say suggests? Student: Of course. The sample was small, after all.
scenes.say_uz: Rahbar: Annotatsiyangiz tushunarli, lekin bo‘shliqni ko‘rmayapman. Talaba: Aksar tadqiqotlar kattalarga qaratilgan. Rahbar: Unda buni ochiq yozing. Yana siz bu ta’sirni isbotlaydi deb yozibsiz. Suggests deyaylikmi? Talaba: Albatta. Axir tanlanma kichik edi.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1 What is missing from the abstract?
3 Why does the student agree to change it?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Diqqat bilan eslang, kerak bo‘lsa dialogni ichingizda qayta tiklang. Birinchi: annotatsiyada nima yetishmayapti? Ikkinchi: qaysi so‘z haddan ortiq qat’iy? Uchinchi: talaba nima uchun o‘zgartirishga rozi bo‘ladi? Javoblaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Three questions. One: what is missing from the abstract? Two: which word is too strong? Three: why does the student agree to change it?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savol. Bir: annotatsiyada nima yetishmayapti? Ikki: qaysi so‘z juda kuchli? Uch: talaba nega o‘zgartirishga rozi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: yetishmayotgani — tadqiqot bo‘shlig‘i, ya’ni aksar ishlar kattalarga qaratilgan, o‘smirlar kam o‘rganilgan. Ikkinchi: haddan kuchli so‘z — “proves”, uni “suggests” ga almashtirishadi. Uchinchi: talaba rozi bo‘ladi, chunki tanlanma kichik edi, ya’ni dalil kuchi katta da’voni ko‘tarmaydi.
scenes.say: The missing element was the research gap. The strong word was proves, which becomes suggests. The student agrees because the sample was small, so the evidence cannot carry a strong claim.
scenes.say_uz: Yetishmayotgan element tadqiqot bo‘shlig‘i edi. Kuchli so‘z proves bo‘lib, suggests ga almashadi. Talaba rozi, chunki tanlanma kichik va dalil kuchli da’voni ko‘tara olmaydi.

scenes.title: Dialog: hakam sharhi
board: Author: We will add a limitations paragraph.
Reviewer: And cite the earlier work.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Jurnal tahririyati hakami muallifga fikr bildiradi. Bu yerda mutaxassislar o‘zaro qanday muloyim, lekin aniq gaplashishini eshiting: “overreaches”, “would benefit from” kabi ibora ehtiyotkor tanqidning o‘zi. Savollar dialogdan keyin.
scenes.say: Reviewer: Overall, the manuscript is well written, but the conclusion somewhat overreaches. Author: In what sense? Reviewer: The data show an association, not a cause. The discussion would also benefit from a limitations paragraph, and Carter's 2015 study should be cited. Author: That is fair. We will revise accordingly.
scenes.say_uz: Hakam: Umuman, qo‘lyozma yaxshi yozilgan, ammo xulosa birmuncha haddan oshadi. Muallif: Qaysi ma’noda? Hakam: Ma’lumotlar bog‘liqlikni ko‘rsatadi, sababni emas. Muhokama cheklovlar xatboshisidan ham foyda ko‘radi, va Karterning 2015 yilgi tadqiqotiga havola berilishi kerak. Muallif: Haqli. Shunga ko‘ra qayta ishlaymiz.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 2 What should be added to the discussion?
3 What does the author agree to do?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog bo‘yicha yana uchta savol. Diqqat bilan eslang, kerak bo‘lsa dialogni ichingizda qayta tiklang. Birinchi: hakamning asosiy tanqidi nima? Ikkinchi: muhokamaga nima qo‘shish kerak? Uchinchi: muallif nima qilishga rozi bo‘ladi? Qisqa javoblarni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Three questions. One: what is the main criticism? Two: what should be added to the discussion? Three: what does the author agree to do?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savol. Bir: asosiy tanqid nima? Ikki: muhokamaga nima qo‘shilishi kerak? Uch: muallif nima qilishga rozi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 The conclusion claims a cause from an association.
2 A limitations paragraph + the Carter citation.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: asosiy tanqid — xulosa bog‘liqlikdan sababga sakrayapti. Ikkinchi: muhokamaga cheklovlar xatboshisi va Karter tadqiqotiga havola qo‘shish kerak. Uchinchi: muallif qo‘lyozmani qayta ishlashga rozi. E’tibor bering, tanqid ham yumshoq til bilan berilgan: “somewhat overreaches”, “would benefit from”
scenes.say: The main criticism is that the conclusion moves from association to cause. The discussion needs a limitations paragraph and the Carter citation. The author agrees to revise. Even the criticism is hedged: somewhat overreaches, would benefit from.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy tanqid: xulosa bog‘liqlikdan sababga o‘tib ketgan. Muhokamaga cheklovlar xatboshisi va Karter havolasi kerak. Muallif qayta ishlashga rozi. Tanqid ham yumshatilgan: somewhat overreaches, would benefit from.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: akademik so‘zlar urg‘usi

examples.t: The analysis supports the hypothesis.

scenes.say_native: Ilmiy so‘zlarda urg‘u joyi o‘zgaradi. “Analysis” da urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda, “analyse” da esa birinchida. “Hypothesis” ning ko‘pligi “hypotheses” oxirida “iiz” bilan aytiladi. “Significant” da urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda, “methodology” da esa asosiy urg‘u uchinchi bo‘g‘inda. “Data” ni britaniyaliklar ko‘pincha “deita” deb aytadi.
scenes.say: Stress matters in academic words: analysis, analyse, hypothesis, hypotheses, significant, methodology. Say them aloud: the analysis supports the hypothesis.
scenes.say_uz: Akademik so‘zlarda urg‘u muhim: analysis, analyse, hypothesis, hypotheses, significant, methodology. Baland ovozda ayting: tahlil gipotezani qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: annotatsiya rejasi
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Masofaviy ish va unumdorlik mavzusida besh gapli annotatsiya aytib bering: fon, maqsad, metod, natija, xulosa. Fonda hozirgi zamon, metod va natijada o‘tgan zamon, xulosada esa bitta hedging vositasini ishlating. Raqamlarni o‘zingiz o‘ylab toping. Pauza oling va fikrni tuzing.
scenes.say: Final task. Compose a five-sentence abstract on remote work and productivity: background, aim, method, result and a cautious conclusion. Use the present for background, the past for method and result, and one hedge.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq. Masofaviy ish va unumdorlik haqida besh gapli annotatsiya tuzing: fon, maqsad, metod, natija va ehtiyotkor xulosa. Fonda hozirgi, metod va natijada o‘tgan zamon va bitta hedging.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
scenes.say_native: Namunani eshiting va o‘zingiznikiga solishtiring. Birinchi gap hozirgi zamonda, ikkinchisi maqsad, uchinchi va to‘rtinchisi o‘tgan zamonda, beshinchisi esa “may” bilan ehtiyotkor. Raqamlar aniq, “significantly” faqat statistik ma’noda. Agar sizda ham shu tartib va shu belgilar bo‘lsa, siz ilmiy annotatsiya yozishni uddaladingiz.
scenes.say: Remote working has expanded rapidly, yet its effect on productivity is debated. This study examined whether working from home changes output. Three hundred employees were surveyed, and their performance data were analysed. Output rose by eight per cent, a statistically significant increase. These findings suggest that remote arrangements may benefit some roles.
scenes.say_uz: Masofaviy ish tez kengaydi, ammo uning unumdorlikka ta’siri munozarali. Ushbu tadqiqot uydan ishlash natijani o‘zgartiradimi-yo‘qmi, shuni o‘rgandi. Uch yuz xodim so‘rovdan o‘tkazildi va ularning ko‘rsatkichlari tahlil qilindi. Natija sakkiz foizga oshdi, bu statistik jihatdan ahamiyatli o‘sish. Bu topilmalar masofaviy tartib ba’zi lavozimlarga foyda keltirishi mumkinligini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Takrorlash
scenes.say_native: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz. Tuzilma: annotatsiya, kirish, metod, natijalar, muhokama, va har bo‘lim o‘z vazifasini bajaradi. Ehtiyotkorlik: da’vo kuchini dalilga moslang, bitta vosita yetarli. Aniqlik: raqam, aniq ot va to‘g‘ri atama. Havola: integral va nointegral usul, fe’l kuchi. Xolislik: majhul nisbat, qisqartmasiz va hissiyotsiz uslub.
scenes.say: To recap: respect the structure, match each claim to its evidence, be precise, cite with the right verb and keep emotion out of the sentence. Those five habits make an article sound scientific.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: tuzilmaga rioya qiling, har bir da’voni dalilga moslang, aniq bo‘ling, to‘g‘ri fe’l bilan havola bering va hissiyotni gapdan chiqaring. Shu besh odat maqolani ilmiy qiladi.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Include: 5 elements, 2 hedges, 1 citation, no contractions
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz tanlagan mavzuda ikki yuz ellik so‘zlik annotatsiya yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: beshta element bo‘lsin, kamida ikkita hedging vositasi, bitta havola, qisqartmalar bo‘lmasin, “significant” faqat statistik ma’noda ishlatilsin va hajmi ikki yuz qirq–ikki yuz oltmish so‘z bo‘lsin. Keyingi darsda Band 9 esse: to‘liq tahlilni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to write a two-hundred-and-fifty-word abstract with all five elements, at least two hedges and one citation. Next time we analyse a complete band nine essay.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: besh elementli, kamida ikki hedging va bitta havolali 250 so‘zlik annotatsiya yozing. Keyingi safar to‘liq 9 ballik essani tahlil qilamiz.

homework_uz: Mavzuni o‘zingiz tanlab, 250 so‘zlik annotatsiya yozing: fon, maqsad, metod, natija va xulosa bo‘lsin; kamida ikkita hedging vositasi va bitta havola ishlating; qisqartma ishlatmang; hajm 240–260 so‘z bo‘lsin.

quiz.q: Which sentence belongs in the results section?
options: Scores rose by 12 per cent in the treatment group.
quiz.why_uz: Natijalar bo‘limi faqat raqamli topilmani beradi; izoh muhokamaga tegishli.

quiz.q: Choose the most appropriately cautious claim.
options: This proves that sleep improves memory.
This suggests that sleep may improve memory.
quiz.why_uz: Suggests va may dalil kuchiga mos; proves, always, everyone esa haddan oshiq.

quiz.q: Which verb distances the writer from the source?
quiz.why_uz: Claims muallifning da’voga to‘liq qo‘shilmasligini bildiradi.

quiz.q: Which sentence is correct academic style?
options: This is a really big problem.
quiz.why_uz: Qisqartma, shaxsiy fikr va kuchaytiruvchi so‘zlar ilmiy uslubga mos emas.

options: According to Lee, he argues sleep matters.
quiz.why_uz: According to bilan keltirish fe’li birga ishlatilmaydi; uchinchi shaxs s ham kerak.

options: A significant lot of people came.
It is a very significant film.
quiz.why_uz: Ilmiy yozuvda significant statistik ma’noda ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: Which phrase is the best replacement for 'a lot of people'?
quiz.why_uz: Ilmiy uslub aniq miqdorni talab qiladi.

quiz.q: Which tense is typical for describing the method?
quiz.why_uz: Metod bajarilgan ish: Data were collected.

options: It would seem that it may possibly be the case that a link exists.
quiz.why_uz: Bir gapda ko‘p hedging o‘quvchini chalg‘itadi; bittasi yetarli.
